site.tagline: Learn to type by copying real stories.

home.title: Lectype — learn to type by copying real stories
home.headline: Learn to touch type by copying real books.
home.intro: Fables, tales, novels and interactive stories, an on-screen keyboard that matches yours, and your speed growing page after page.

errors.csrf: The form has expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

typing.hint: Type the text. Escape to go back to the book.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoHint: Automatic works in Chrome and Edge. In other browsers, choose your layout.
settings.strictHint: Only the exact character is accepted.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: Type a page, a story chapter or a lesson: your progress will show here.
stats.localNote: Without an account, your statistics stay in this browser.

stories.title: Stories
stories.interactiveSubtitle: Every choice is typed on the keyboard.
stories.chooseHint: Type one of the sentences to choose.
stories.restartConfirm: Start the story over? Your progress and choices will be erased.

learn.title: Learn

stageSubtitles.homeRow: Where your fingers rest. Everything starts here.
stageSubtitles.topRow: Reach up, then come back to the home row.
stageSubtitles.bottomRow: Reach down, then come back to the home row.
stageSubtitles.capitals: Hold Shift with the other hand.
stageSubtitles.accents: The special letters of your language.

learn.introHint: Rest your fingers on the home row. Press Space to start.
learn.failedHint: You need at least 90% accuracy to earn a star.
learn.allDone: Well done, you finished the whole path!

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Your account keeps your progress and statistics on all your devices.
signup.privacy: By creating an account, you accept our privacy policy.

login.title: Log in
login.remember: Stay logged in on this device (30 days)

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your address: if an account exists, you will receive a link to choose a new password.

problems.firstName: Enter your first name (60 characters at most).
problems.email: This email address is not valid.
problems.confirm: The two passwords do not match.
problems.notVerified: Confirm your email address first with the link you received.

password.tooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
password.tooLong: The password is too long (72 bytes at most).
password.tooCommon: This password is too common. Choose another one.
password.personal: The password must not contain your first name or your address.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If the address {email} can be used, an email has just been sent to it. Click the link inside to continue. Remember to check your spam folder.

checkEmailReset.title: Check your email
checkEmailReset.body: If an account exists for {email}, a link to change your password has just been sent. It is valid for one hour.

verified.title: Address confirmed
verified.body: Your account is ready. You can now log in.

linkInvalid.title: Invalid link
linkInvalid.body: This link has expired or has already been used.

passwordReset.title: Password changed
passwordReset.body: Your new password is saved. All your devices have been logged out.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.body:
Hello {firstName},

To finish creating your Lectype account, open this link (valid for 24 hours):
{link}

If you did not create an account, ignore this email.

accountExists.subject: Account creation attempt

reset.subject: Change your password
reset.body:
Hello {firstName},

To choose a new password, open this link (valid for one hour):
{link}

If you didn't ask for anything, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
